Maya P (PM): quick sync — we need to lock scope for the compliance work we promised to enterprise customers before Q3 planning. main asks: BYOK/KMS, audit logs export + retention controls, SOC2 evidence. want to avoid open ended scope creep :eyes:

Alex W (Eng): +1. can we break into MVP vs Stretch? i think BYOK MVP = key import + bind to tenant. full HSM/BYOK rotation later.

Sam T (Customer Success): customer ask from Acme: BYOK + ability to retain logs 13 months. they need exports for their auditors. pushing hard.

Rachel L (Infra): storage/cost note — 13mo per-tenant immutable logs will increase S3 tier costs ~x. we should offer default 90d then a paid extension for >90d.

Jordan S (Security): must confirm encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys for their logs. BYOK MVP should support AWS KMS and GCP KMS import. HSM/KMS-backed keys (external HSM) is stretch. also need tamper-evidence for audit logs (append-only + signing).

Priya K (Legal): EU customers need export + right-to-be-forgotten handling. retention extension is fine but we must provide delete/erase workflows and DSR owners. also SOC2 asks for documentation of key management policies.

Maya P (PM): proposal draft for scope:
- BYOK MVP: key import (AWS/GCP KMS only), mapping UI + API, restrict key use to artifact encryption and logs. no rotation automation in MVP.
- Audit-log v1: schema + append-only store, default retention 90d, per-tenant retention override up to 12mo behind feature-flag. export API (JSONL) + on-demand export job.
- SOC2 prep: run gap analysis vs. controls (owner: Jordan), collect evidence for KMS use, retention config, incident response docs.

Alex W (Eng): rough ETA: BYOK import backend + API ~2 dev-weeks, UI + validation ~1 week. audit-log v1 core + export job ~3 dev-weeks, infra work ~2 infra-weeks for storage + signing. these can overlap.

Rachel L (Infra): infra work depends on signing approach. we can do HMAC-signed manifests now (cheap) then swap to KMS-backed signing later. also need lifecycle policies for object tiering.

Jordan S (Security): agree on HMAC staging. but SOC2 reviewers will want KMS-backed key material in long term. add a control: all production keys must be rotatable and auditable by ops.

Sam T (Customer Success): customers will push for 13mo. can we make "paid retention" option 12mo to close Acme short term? they might accept 12 over 13.

Priya K (Legal): 12mo helps. ensure export tool includes user/account identifiers redaction option (for DSARs). legal sign-off required before enabling >90d retention for EU tenants.

Maya P (PM): ok decision path: MVP target = BYOK import (AWS/GCP) + audit-log v1 + export API + retention flag up to 12mo. SOC2 gap analysis concurrent. Stretch: HSM support, rotation automation, per-tenant custom retention beyond 12mo.

security-bot: scheduled: "SOC2-gap-run-1769130000" started by Jordan S

Alex W (Eng): blockers? depends on KMS credential flow. need clarity on customer key import UX + verification (proof-of-possession).

Jordan S (Security): proof-of-possession: require customer to sign a nonce with their key via KMS Sign API or use envelope encryption flow for verification. prefer Sign API for AWS KMS. document in spec.

Maya P (PM): good. add simple spec snippet for audit-log schema (v1):
```json
{
  "timestamp": "iso8601",
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "request_id": "string",
  "actor": { "id":"string", "type":"system|user|service" },
  "action": "string",
  "resource": "string",
  "outcome": "success|failure",
  "meta": { "ip":"string", "region":"string" }
}
```

Rachel L (Infra): small ask — include shard key on tenant_id to keep partitions clean, and a sequence number for append-only verification.

Alex W (Eng): agree. export API will paginate by sequence and support resume. we'll produce JSONL and a signed manifest for each export.

Priya K (Legal): please add retention policy metadata into manifest: retention_until, legal_hold boolean, export_purpose. we need traceability for audits.

Maya P (PM): owners + milestones:
- Spec doc and API design (owner: Alex) — draft by 1 week (1769130600).
- Infra design + cost estimate (owner: Rachel) — 1.5 weeks.
- SOC2 gap analysis (owner: Jordan) — 2 weeks.
- Legal sign-off for EU retention >90d (owner: Priya) — gating for rollout.
- CS pricing + pilot offer (owner: Sam) — 2 weeks.

Alex W (Eng): I'll post an RFC in #eng-platform with API examples. can someone confirm we can use existing key vault for BYOK metadata?

Rachel L (Infra): yes we can reuse key-metadata store but we must add tenant isolation. infra change: +2 infra-weeks to harden metadata store.

Sam T (Customer Success): i'll line up pilot customers (Acme + BetaBank) and capture auditor requirements.

Jordan S (Security): I'll include acceptance criteria for SOC2 evidence: KMS usage logs, proof-of-possession records, immutable audit manifests, retention policy enforcement tests.

Maya P (PM): consensus check: who objects to MVP scope as defined? :point_up:

Alex W (Eng): no objections.

Rachel L (Infra): no objections but call out cost gating and feature flag for >90d.

Jordan S (Security): no objections. add TODO: create replay tests to detect log tampering.

Priya K (Legal): no objections. will draft DSAR workflow doc.

Sam T (Customer Success): no objections. will prep customer comms.

Maya P (PM): great — next step i will create the product ticket with owners + RFC link. goal: cut initial tickets by EOD tomorrow. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
